posts.cooked:
I’m assuming Completionist Guise will be the last thing added to the game after all the OblivAeon stuff, so he actually completes your collection. So in terms of official content still to be added, it looks like:

11 new heroes:

- Stuntman (mini pack 4)

- Benchmark (mini pack 4)

- Idealist (mini pack 5)

- Dr Medico (mini pack 5)

- Mainstay (mini pack 5)

- Writhe (mini pack 5)

- Luminary (OblivAeon)

- The Harpy (OblivAeon)

- La Comodora (OblivAeon)

- Lifeline (OblivAeon)

- Akash’Thriya (OblivAeon)

 

12 Hero Varients - one for each of the above + Completionist Guise

 

1 Villain - Chokepoint (Mini pack 4, already available if you have Season 2 pass)

 

6 Environments:

- Celestial Tribunal (mini pack 4)

- Fort Adamant (OblivAeon)

- Nexus of the Void (OblivAeon) 

- Champions Studios (OblivAeon) 

- Mordengrad (OblivAeon)

- Maerynian Refuge (OblivAeon)

 

1 new game mode - OblivAeon, which looks to have a fair amount of variety in and of itself due to mixes of shields, scions and missions, etc.

I don’t regret pitching in to get one of my own, I really like the story and concept behind him, but I don’t think he’s that great. Someone tell me how to make him useful. ._.

It’s quite useful, really.

“Discard the top card of a deck. You may either play or destroy a card that shares a keyword with the discarded card.”

First, it’s additional card play for Legacy, who really shines once he’s got more cards in play.

Second, it’s card destruction, which he doesn’t have in his deck.

Third, it’s keyword based destruction, which is very powerful. It could let you destroy Scion cards from Progeny’s deck, for example. The Dreamer is another villain it would be strong against.

posts.cooked:
Dark Conductor is the official replacement for Kvothe Six-String, as

1) Kvothe is a character owed by someone else (He's from Patrick Rothfuss' Name of the Wind) and

2) it was a special, limited-edition promo card created specifically for Rothfuss' Worldbuilders charity fundraisers.

As such, GTG pledged not to use that card in other things, but created Dark Conductor to replicate the functionality of it for those who didn’t get Kvothe through the fundraiser.

Edit: Fixed "Six-String"
